notes: Prototype heuristics on synthetic data, not validated thresholds.

Geographic dispersion is corroborating, not required: in the base synthetic dataset only about 10% of claims are in the member's home state, so care location is independent of residence and dispersion does not separate providers. It is always computed and displayed.
Prior care context = a prior claim for the same service code by any provider, or a referral to this provider dated on or before the first recent claim. Diagnosis data is not available.
Weights are prototype heuristics; the result is a similarity score, not a probability of misconduct.
Timing is excluded from the supporting-component count because every eligible pair is close in time by construction.
Missing identifiers are never treated as matches; unavailable components contribute zero and are disclosed.
